## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 attacks the **Q23 A_s-magnitude rate-limiter** — the single highest-EVOI item carried into S118. S117 W1 left the A_s magnitude a 3-member plurality {+0.196 (H̃/ζ, TD), +0.384 (Route-B GGE-modular), +0.864 (ξ_KZ box-δ)} OOM relative to Planck, with the dominant fork being the **2-member 0.668-OOM gap** between the acoustic-horizon (H̃, +0.196, `A_s=3.2994e-9`) grid and the impulse-quench (box-δ, +0.864, `A_s_FW=1.5367e-8`) grid. The S117 GS-1 gate (`CF-S117-GS-1`, audit `d7f28d3e…`, verdict **INFO-RESIDUAL-PREFACTOR**) established that the deg=+2 substrate→pivot transport is the **sole carrier** of that 0.668-OOM gap **iff** the between-grid scale separation `Δ_scale ∈ [0.2841, 0.3841]`, equivalently the substrate hydrodynamic-IR sound speed `c_s ∈ [0.5163972, 0.6501056]` M_KK — and that the two analogue endpoints **straddle** that window (`c_BLV=0.485` below, `c_Gold=0.915` above) so the fork was NOT closed by either endpoint.

Wave 1 resolves the straddle from the substrate:

- **W1-1 `CF-S118-AS-CS-SUBSTRATE-FIRST`** (transit-dynamics-theorist, PRIMARY): compute `c_s` from substrate first principles — the spectral-action **a₂ curvature-channel** (hydrodynamic-IR) first-sound/second-sound ratio at the post-fold GGE two-fluid state — and test membership in the GS-1 window. PASS ⇒ GS-1 PHYSICS-SCALE-SEPARATION fires ⇒ the A_s fork resolves to the acoustic-horizon (H̃, +0.196) grid ⇒ Q23 closes to a **zero-parameter** magnitude. FAIL ⇒ route to the FAIL-branch carry-forward `CF-S118-AS-PREFACTOR-SOURCE` (identify the residual non-scale prefactor — greybody Γ / c_sub Mellin-weight / F_amp backreaction — co-carrying the 0.40-OOM shortfall).
- **W1-2 `CF-S118-ALT-GREYBODY-WALL`** (volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist): upgrade the atlas-09 exit-greybody "structural-wall candidate" (S117 1-4 FAIL; 3 knob-free classes — Pöschl-Teller, Wodzicki-PV Γ=a₂/a₄, Connes-distance — all missed) toward an actual wall (route b: a structural no-go) OR falsify it (route a: a 4th knob-free class — a full BdG S-matrix transmission on the exit-horizon sector — that reaches a target). This is the FAIL-branch hedge: if 1-1 FAILs, whether the residual prefactor is greybody-sourced turns on whether a knob-free greybody EXISTS.

The two items have **distinct executors** (transit-dynamics-theorist | volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist) and **no intra-wave data dependency** — they may dispatch in parallel.

    it floors near unity (Γ → 1), unable to reach {0.137, 0.512, 0.637} without a

                                          Hawking-greybody = |T|²; equals the modulus
                                          a_gen = |O_g| = Γ(ω) e^{-2πω/κ} of the exit filter]
    Def 2: BdG S-matrix unitarity: S†S = 1 ⇒ |T(ω)|² + |R(ω)|² = 1

           bulk (M_reg < λ_max — a KNOB; s117_alt_greybody.py lines 46-49 KNOB-LOCATION).
    Conclusion: Γ ≤ 1 always (sign); knob-free Γ floors near 1 (route b no-go direction)
           UNLESS a 4th-class construction supplies a substrate-natural sub-unity Γ at
           M_reg ≥ λ_max (route a falsification).

# ---- Composite-precedence (PLAN-FROZEN operator; per gate-verdicts.md
#      §"Plan-frozen gate-block operator precedence") ----
# The two-branch adjudication overrides the generic 3-tuple collapse. The producing
# script MUST emit a `# composite-precedence:` companion extra-row naming this anchor.
# Order (route_b_valid_nogo and route_a_hit are LOGICALLY EXCLUSIVE — a valid no-go
# means no knob-free greybody exists ⇒ route_a cannot hit ⇒ no PASS-collision):
#   if route_b_valid_nogo:  composite = PASS  (outcome=STRUCTURAL-WALL)             [strongest]
#   elif route_a_hit:       composite = PASS  (outcome=CANDIDATE-FALSIFIED)
#   elif route_a_miss:      composite = FAIL  (outcome=WALL-STRENGTHENED-4-CLASS-EMPIRICAL)
#   else:                   composite = INFO  (outcome=INDETERMINATE)
# value= field MUST encode outcome=STRUCTURAL-WALL | CANDIDATE-FALSIFIED |
# WALL-STRENGTHENED-4-CLASS-EMPIRICAL | INDETERMINATE so the two PASS readings are
# distinguishable in the audit trail.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Either (route b) a valid structural no-go ⇒ the exit-greybody candidate promotes to a
  STRUCTURAL WALL (knob-free spectral geometry cannot supply sub-unity Γ at any physical
  M_reg ≥ λ_max; the S95 fitted 0.512 has NO substrate scale) — value=outcome=STRUCTURAL-WALL;
  OR (route a) a 4th-class knob-free Γ reaches a target within rel_dev 0.10 at M_reg ≥ λ_max
  ⇒ a substrate-derivable greybody EXISTS and the wall candidate is FALSIFIED —
  value=outcome=CANDIDATE-FALSIFIED. The two PASS readings are mutually exclusive and
  audit-distinguished in value=.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Route (a) misses (no 4th-class knob-free Γ reaches a target at M_reg ≥ λ_max) AND route (b)
  supplies no valid no-go ⇒ the wall is EMPIRICALLY strengthened to 4 classes but NOT proven
  structurally — value=outcome=WALL-STRENGTHENED-4-CLASS-EMPIRICAL. The A_s upper-edge
  greybody factor remains NOT substrate-derivable (a fitted knob); the magnitude PLURALISM
  is unchanged.
INFO_meaning: >
  Route (a) miss with a borderline route-(b) no-go (margin marginal / regime ambiguous) ⇒
  value=outcome=INDETERMINATE. The no-go is suggestive but not conclusive; reserved as a
  next-session structural-proof carry-forward.

|:-------------|:------------|

Fold into §EVOI.BF (A_s plurality collapses to the H̃ grid); atlas-08 Q23 → RESOLVED; mack-surface A_s falsifier row re-pinned to 3.2994e-9; capstone §7 amplitude anchor updated (capstone-hygiene Q3 status change → designated-writer patch). The box-δ (+0.864) grid is demoted to a regime-diagnostic only. **`CF-S118-ALT-GREYBODY-WALL` (W1-2) becomes moot for A_s closure** (no residual prefactor needed) but stands on its own as the atlas-09 wall adjudication. |
| **INFO** (bracketed, residual 0.10–0.25) | A_s plurality **SHARPENED, not closed**. Both Track A (H̃) and Track B (box-δ) remain; the residual non-scale prefactor carries a sub-dominant share. Carry-forward `CF-S119-AS-PREFACTOR-SHARE` (quantify the residual prefactor split between greybody / c_sub / F_amp). §EVOI.BF folds the sharpened bound. |
| **FAIL** (residual > 0.25, or sign FAIL / bracket violated) | The deg=+2 transport is NOT the sole carrier ⇒ route to **`CF-S118-AS-PREFACTOR-SOURCE`** (the conditional FAIL-branch named in the context): identify which residual non-scale prefactor (greybody Γ / c_sub Mellin-weight / F_amp backreaction) carries the 0.40-OOM shortfall. **W1-2's verdict directly informs this**: a route-(b) WALL ⇒ greybody is NOT the prefactor source (eliminates one of three); a route-(a) FALSIFIED ⇒ greybody is a live prefactor candidate. |

| W1-2 outcome | Consequence |
|:-------------|:------------|
| **PASS / STRUCTURAL-WALL** | atlas-09 Item-49 candidate → registered structural wall ("A_s upper-edge NOT substrate-derivable" is a theorem). mack-surface + atlas-09 update (designated-writer). Eliminates greybody from the CF-S118-AS-PREFACTOR-SOURCE candidate set (if W1-1 FAILed). |
